recognize_zh: 骨髓抹片中央有一顆大型巨噬細胞，核卵圓、細胞質淡染泡沫狀，周圍環繞許多深染圓核的晚期有核紅血球，形成紅血球生成島（erythroblastic island）。
features: Central macrophage with an oval nucleus, fine chromatin and abundant pale, vacuolated cytoplasm
Numerous orthochromatic and polychromatic normoblasts with dense round nuclei surrounding and overlying the macrophage
A few earlier erythroid and myeloid precursors at the periphery, including a band/segmented neutrophil
Normal-appearing erythroid maturation without megaloblastic change
Surrounding red cells with drying artifact
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows an erythroblastic island consisting of a central macrophage with an oval nucleus and abundant pale, finely vacuolated cytoplasm. The macrophage is surrounded by numerous late polychromatic and orthochromatic normoblasts with dense round nuclei, and a few earlier precursors and granulocytes are seen at the periphery. Erythroid maturation appears orderly without megaloblastic or dysplastic changes. This is a normal structural unit of erythropoiesis, in which the central macrophage supplies iron and phagocytoses extruded nuclei.

ddx.vs: In hemophagocytosis the macrophage has engulfed intact cells within cytoplasmic vacuoles, whereas here normoblasts are attached around the macrophage surface in an orderly arrangement.
Lymphoid aggregates consist of small lymphocytes with scant cytoplasm and clumped chromatin, lacking a central macrophage and the dense pyknotic normoblast nuclei.
Tumor clusters are cohesive with large pleomorphic nuclei and lack a central macrophage and maturing normoblasts.
